nodes.zh: 任务

nodes.text: Durable state machines that checkpoint every phase, own their children, and abort from the bottom up.
nodes.zh: 在每个阶段都做检查点、拥有自己的子任务、并自底向上中止的持久状态机。

nodes.text: 5 . 1 Tasks as state machines
nodes.zh: 5.1 任务即状态机

nodes.text: A task is work cut into phases, and its stored record is the only thing about it that survives a crash.
nodes.zh: 任务是被切成若干阶段的工作，而关于它的全部信息中，唯一能在崩溃后存续下来的，是它的存储记录。

nodes.text: Say your agent is halfway through charging a card when the laptop lid closes. When the process comes back, something has to say how far it got. In Pi Durable that something is a task. After this section you can write a task, name its five states, and read a task record in storage.
nodes.zh: 假设你的智能体正在给一张卡扣款，中途笔记本合上了。进程恢复后，必须有某个东西说明它进行到了哪一步。在 Pi Durable 中，这个东西就是任务。读完本节，你可以编写一个任务、说出它的五种状态，并从存储中读取一条任务记录。

nodes.text: A task is a list of phases
nodes.zh: 任务就是一份阶段列表

nodes.text: A task is a unit of work that the Harness commits as it goes. You split it into phases, named steps such as prepare and charge. When a phase finishes its part, it commits a checkpoint: a small JSON value that names the next phase and holds whatever that phase needs. A commit is an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. If the process dies, the next process reads the last checkpoint and runs that phase again. Nothing else carries over. Variables and closures are gone; only the stored record remains. All work in Pi Durable runs this way, including the Harness’s own model calls, tool calls and compactions. You write a task with defineTask() and register it in an extension’s tasks list. The Harness finds the code by the task’s name each time it starts the task (extensions and the registry (p. 103)).
nodes.zh: 任务是 Harness 在推进过程中逐步提交的一份工作单元。你把它拆成若干阶段——诸如 `prepare` 和 `charge` 这样的具名步骤。当一个阶段做完它的那部分，就提交一个检查点：一个小的 JSON 值，指明下一个阶段，并携带该阶段需要的一切。提交是一次原子保存：其中的内容要么一起存下，要么都不存。如果进程死了，下一个进程就读取最后一个检查点，重新运行那个阶段。别的什么都不保留。变量和闭包都没了，只剩下存储的记录。Pi Durable 里所有工作都是这样运行的，包括 Harness 自己的模型调用、工具调用和压缩。你用 `defineTask()` 编写一个任务，并在某个扩展的 `tasks` 列表中注册它。Harness 每次启动该任务时都按任务名找到这段代码（扩展与注册表（p. 103））。

nodes.text: a two-phase payment task test/examples/12-tasks.ts TS

const checkpoint = { phase: "charge", key: `payment-${task.id}` } as const;
const key = task.state.checkpoint.key; if (!payments.has(key)) payments.set(key, task.input.amount * 100);
const outcome = { status: "completed", result: { receipt } } as const; await runtime.commit(() => ({ status: "terminal", outcome }), taskContext);

nodes.text: Five states
nodes.zh: 五种状态

nodes.text: A task is always in one of five states src/types.ts. Three are live. pending means it is waiting its turn to run. running means code is executing it now. waiting means it is paused until other tasks finish. The other two hold a result. completing means the result is decided but work the task started is still running. terminal means it is finished for good, and the record is now a receipt.
nodes.zh: 任务永远处于五种状态之一（`src/types.ts`）。其中三种是活的。`pending` 表示它在排队等待运行。`running` 表示此刻有代码在执行它。`waiting` 表示它已暂停，直到其他任务完成。另外两种持有结果。`completing` 表示结果已定，但它启动的工作还在运行。`terminal` 表示它已彻底结束，此时记录就是一张回执。

nodes.text: A task has five states; your code commits checkpoints, waits and outcomes, and the Harness does the rest. Edges from src/harness/scheduler.ts. An abort-marked waiting task also leaves waiting early to run its abort handler; an abort-marked pending or waiting task that no code can take ends orphaned.
nodes.zh: 一个任务有五种状态；你的代码提交检查点、等待和 outcome，剩下的由 Harness 完成。边取自 `src/harness/scheduler.ts`。一个带中止标记的 waiting 任务也会提前离开 waiting 去运行它的中止处理器；一个带中止标记、又没有任何代码能接手的 pending 或 waiting 任务则最终落到 orphaned。

nodes.text: Your code moves a task only through runtime.commit(). A phase can commit a new checkpoint and stay running, start a wait, or finish with terminal. It can never set pending. Only the Harness does that, when it reopens after a crash or hands a task to newly loaded code. The Harness also writes faults, orphans and abort marks: “The scheduler owns reservation, reconciliation, handover, faults, and orphaning; abortTask() owns abort marks” spec §5.1. If a phase finishes while tasks it started are still running, the Harness stores it as completing instead (ownership (p. 76)).
nodes.zh: 你的代码只能通过 `runtime.commit()` 移动任务。一个阶段可以提交新的检查点并保持 running，可以开始一次等待，也可以以 terminal 结束。它永远不能设置 pending。只有 Harness 会这么做——在崩溃后重开，或把任务交给新加载的代码时。Harness 还负责写入故障、孤儿和中止标记：「调度器拥有预留、对账、交接、故障和孤儿化；`abortTask()` 拥有中止标记」（spec §5.1）。如果一个阶段结束时它启动的任务还在运行，Harness 会把它存成 completing（所有权（p. 76））。

nodes.text: What a phase can call
nodes.zh: 阶段能调用什么

nodes.text: Each phase handler receives (task, runtime, context). task is the stored record. runtime is the toolbox for this one run of the task, and it stops working when the run ends src/types.ts.
nodes.zh: 每个阶段处理器收到 `(task, runtime, context)`。`task` 是存储的记录。`runtime` 是这次任务运行的工具箱，这次运行结束就失效（`src/types.ts`）。

nodes.text: runtime.commit() is the one way to commit. Your callback receives a transaction and the current record. It may append entries, write documents and create child tasks, and it may return the task’s next state. All of it lands in one atomic commit, so a checkpoint can never disagree with the data it describes. Entries committed this way record the task as their author (byTaskId) spec §5.1. The commit rejects if the run has ended, the Harness is closing, the task is no longer running, or the task carries an abort mark.
nodes.zh: `runtime.commit()` 是唯一的提交方式。你的回调会收到一个事务和当前记录。它可以追加条目、写入文档、创建子任务，也可以返回任务的下一种状态。所有这些都落在同一次原子提交里，所以检查点永远不会和它所描述的数据不一致。以这种方式提交的条目会把该任务记为它们的作者（`byTaskId`）（spec §5.1）。如果这次运行已经结束、Harness 正在关闭、任务已不在 running，或任务带有中止标记，提交都会被拒绝。

nodes.caption: Beforeeachphasethestepappliesthefirstmatchingrule ; noprogressisafault . Rulesfromspec §5.1, implementedinsrc / harness / scheduler . ts .
nodes.zh_caption: 每个阶段之前，step 会套用第一条匹配的规则；没有进展就是故障。规则来自 spec §5.1，实现在 `src/harness/scheduler.ts`。

nodes.text: 5 . 2 Phases, steps and progress
nodes.zh: 5.2 阶段、步骤与进度

nodes.text: A phase that commits nothing new would run forever, so the Harness stops the task with a fault instead.
nodes.zh: 一个什么新东西都不提交的阶段会永远运行，所以 Harness 改为用故障停掉这个任务。

nodes.text: A task runs one phase after another. Between phases the Harness makes a quick check: is the task finished, aborted or shutting down, and did the last phase commit progress? After this section you can predict that check for any phase, design phases that always make progress, and use memos and sleep safely.
nodes.zh: 任务一个阶段接一个阶段地运行。阶段之间 Harness 做一个快速检查：任务是否已完成、中止或正在关闭，以及上一个阶段是否提交了进展。读完本节，你就能对任何阶段预测这次检查，设计始终有进展的阶段，并安全地使用 memos 和 sleep。

nodes.text: One run, many phases
nodes.zh: 一次运行，多个阶段

nodes.text: When the Harness starts a task, it creates an invocation: one in-memory run of the task, with its own abort signal. An invocation runs phase after phase until the task finishes, waits or is stopped. Committing a checkpoint does not end it. The next phase starts right away, in the same process. Before each phase the Harness runs a step, a short check that reads the committed record and decides whether to go on. The step is itself a commit on the Session’s single queue of writes (the commit (p. 29)), so it sees every commit the phase made before returning. A commit that reaches the queue after the step is rejected with invocation has ended test/harness-tasks.test.ts.
nodes.zh: Harness 启动一个任务时，会创建一个 invocation：任务在内存中的一次运行，带着自己的中止信号。一个 invocation 会一个阶段接一个阶段地运行，直到任务完成、等待或被停止。提交检查点并不会结束它。下一个阶段立刻在同一个进程里开始。每个阶段之前，Harness 会运行一个 step——一段读取已提交记录、决定是否继续的简短检查。step 本身就是 Session 单一写入队列上的一次提交（提交（p. 29）），所以它在返回前能看到该阶段做过的每一次提交。在 step 之后才进入队列的提交会被拒绝，报 `invocation has ended`（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: Before each phase the step applies the first matching rule; no progress is a fault. Rules from spec §5.1, implemented in src/harness/scheduler.ts.
nodes.zh: 每个阶段之前，step 会套用第一条匹配的规则；没有进展就是故障。规则来自 spec §5.1，实现在 `src/harness/scheduler.ts`。

nodes.text: The six rules
nodes.zh: 六条规则

nodes.text: Before the first phase only rules 1–3 apply, because nothing has returned yet. After a phase returns, the first rule that matches wins: 1. Finished, completing or waiting: stop. The phase committed an outcome or a wait. There is nothing more to run. 2. The Harness is closing: stop. The checkpoint and any abort mark stay for the next process. Closing never writes an outcome. 3. Abort mark: stop this run. A separate abort run starts later, once the task’s own child work has finished (abort (p. 80)). 4. The phase threw: write faulted with the error’s message. Like every outcome, it is held as completing while the task’s
nodes.zh: 第一个阶段之前只有规则 1–3 适用，因为还没有任何东西返回。一个阶段返回后，第一条匹配的规则获胜：1. 已完成、completing 或 waiting：停。该阶段提交了 outcome 或一次等待。没有更多东西要运行。2. Harness 正在关闭：停。检查点和任何中止标记都留给下一个进程。关闭从不写 outcome。3. 有中止标记：结束本次运行。之后会单独启动一次中止运行，等该任务自己的子工作完成后进行（中止（p. 80））。4. 阶段抛出：写入 faulted 和该错误的消息。和每个 outcome 一样，在该任务的

nodes.text: child work is still live (ownership (p. 76)).
nodes.zh: 子工作仍存活期间，它会以 completing 持有（所有权（p. 76））。

nodes.text: 5. Checkpoint changed: continue with the next phase, or hand the task to newly loaded code (the scheduler (p. 73)). 6. Checkpoint unchanged: write faulted, “because no durable progress was made”, held as completing in the same way
nodes.zh: 5. 检查点变了：继续进入下一个阶段，或把任务交给新加载的代码（调度器（p. 73））。6. 检查点没变：写入 faulted，原因是「没有取得持久进展」，同样以 completing 持有，

nodes.text: while child work is live.
nodes.zh: 只要子工作还存活。

nodes.text: The order matters in two cases. A phase that commits a new checkpoint and then throws is still faulted, because rule 4 comes before rule 5. A phase that commits a final outcome and then throws keeps its outcome, because rule 1 comes first. Any commit it attempts after that rejects with Task N is terminal test/harness-tasks.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 顺序在两种情况下至关重要。一个提交了新检查点随后抛出的阶段仍然是 faulted，因为规则 4 在规则 5 之前。一个提交了最终 outcome 随后抛出的阶段会保留它的 outcome，因为规则 1 在最前。此后它尝试的任何提交都会被拒绝，报 `Task N is terminal`（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: Why no progress is a fault
nodes.zh: 为什么没有进展算故障

nodes.text: A phase that ends with the checkpoint it started with would run again with the same input, forever. So the step compares the two checkpoints as JSON, ignoring key order. If they are equal, it faults the task with Task test.idle phase run returned without durable progress test/harness-tasks.test.ts. Three patterns trip this rule:
nodes.zh: 一个结束时检查点还和开始时一样的阶段，会带着同样的输入永远重复运行。所以 step 把两个检查点当作 JSON 比较，忽略键序。如果相等，它就用 `Task test.idle phase run returned without durable progress` 让任务进入故障（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。三种写法会踩到这条规则：

nodes.text: The phase returns without committing anything.
nodes.zh: 阶段返回时没有提交任何东西。

nodes.text: The phase commits entries or documents but returns no new state from runtime.commit(). Only the checkpoint counts as
nodes.zh: 阶段提交了条目或文档，但没有从 `runtime.commit()` 返回新状态。只有检查点才算

nodes.text: progress.
nodes.zh: 进展。

nodes.text: The phase commits a copy that equals the old checkpoint.
nodes.zh: 阶段提交了一份与旧检查点相同的副本。

nodes.text: A phase may run itself again, as long as the checkpoint changes. Example 13’s ticker has a single phase, tick, and commits { phase: "tick", n: n + 1 } on each pass. The phase name stays the same, the checkpoint does not, so rule 5 continues.
nodes.zh: 一个阶段可以再次运行自己，只要检查点发生变化。示例 13 的 ticker 只有一个阶段 `tick`，每轮提交 `{ phase: "tick", n: n + 1 }`。阶段名不变，检查点变了，所以规则 5 让它继续。

nodes.text: Memos: remember a small decision
nodes.zh: memos：记住一个小决定

nodes.text: A memo is a small named value stored on the task record. The first write wins. runtime.memo(name, candidate) commits the candidate only if the name is still empty, and returns the stored winner either way. runtime.memo(name) only reads spec §5.2. Two writes of "a" and "b" at the same time both get "a" back test/harness-tasks.test.ts. Memos survive restarts and are dropped when the task finishes. Committing a memo does not count as progress. Use a memo to keep one effect inside a phase from repeating. Example 13 prints each tick once, even when its phase runs twice:

nodes.text: 5 . 3 The effect sandwich
nodes.zh: 5.3 效果三明治

nodes.text: Commit what you are about to do, do it, then commit what happened; a crash in the middle leaves a clear question, not a silent gap.
nodes.zh: 提交你打算做的事，执行它，再提交实际发生的事；中途崩溃留下的是一个明确的问题，而不是一段无声的空白。

nodes.text: The Harness can commit its own records atomically, but it cannot make a card charge, a deploy or an email atomic with them. If the process dies right after the charge, did the customer pay? After this section you can split any outside action into phases so that every crash point has a defined, safe recovery.
nodes.zh: Harness 能原子地提交自己的记录，但无法让一次扣卡、一次部署或一封邮件与它们原子。进程若恰好在扣款之后死掉，客户到底付了钱没有？读完本节，你就能把任何外部动作拆成若干阶段，使每个崩溃点都有明确而安全的恢复路径。

nodes.text: Why effects need their own phase
nodes.zh: 为什么效果需要自己的阶段

nodes.text: An effect is anything that changes the world outside storage: a payment, an API call, a file on another machine. Effects may not run inside a commit spec §1, invariant 4. A commit holds the Session’s write queue, so waiting on the network there would stall every other writer (the commit (p. 29)). An effect therefore always happens between two commits, and the process can die between them. The spec’s answer is a fixed shape:
nodes.zh: 效果就是任何改变存储之外世界的东西：一笔支付、一次 API 调用、另一台机器上的一个文件。效果不得在提交内部运行（spec §1，不变式 4）。一次提交会占住 Session 的写入队列，在那里等待网络会拖住所有其他写者（提交（p. 29））。因此效果总是发生在两次提交之间，而进程可能死在它们中间。规范给出的答案是固定形状：

nodes.text: commit intent phase perform external effect commit outcome or next phase spec §5.2, verbatim.
nodes.zh: 提交意图 阶段 执行外部效果 提交结果或下一阶段 spec §5.2，原文。

nodes.text: Commit the intent, perform the effect, commit the outcome; a crash in the middle reruns the effect phase. The phases of spec §5.1’s payment example. Step 4’s entry and final state land in one commit.

nodes.text: The spec’s own example has three parts. prepare creates an idempotency key and commits it as the next checkpoint. charge performs the effect with that key, then appends a receipt entry and finishes the task in the same commit. The abort handler undoes the charge and commits aborted.

nodes.text: Every crash point, and what reopening finds
nodes.zh: 每一个崩溃点，以及重开时会发现什么

nodes.text: When a new process opens the storage, every task that was running goes back to pending with its checkpoint (the scheduler (p. 73)). The checkpoint, not the process, says where the task stood:
nodes.zh: 新进程打开存储时，每一个当时在 running 的任务都会带着它的检查点退回 pending（调度器（p. 73））。是检查点而非进程说明任务当时处在什么位置：

nodes.text: The Harness cannot know whether the request reached the payment service before the process died, so your phase must be correct either way. The spec names three ways: “The phase handler retries safely, polls an external handle, or records interruption” spec §5.2.
nodes.zh: Harness 无法知道在进程死掉之前请求有没有到达支付服务，所以你的阶段无论如何都必须正确。规范给出三种方式：「阶段处理器安全地重试、轮询一个外部句柄，或记录中断」（spec §5.2）。

nodes.text: Retry safely — send an idempotency key created in the intent phase and stored in the checkpoint. In the recovery test the transfer service is called twice, across a close and reopen, yet applies the transfer once, because both calls carry transfer-N test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts. Poll a handle — when the remote system returns an operation ID, commit it before waiting, then ask the remote system for the result. The generation task does this for deferred model calls (generation (p. 91)). Record interruption — when neither is possible, commit an outcome that says the effect may or may not have happened. Tool calls not marked replay: "safe" do this (tool calls and replay (p. 94)).
nodes.zh: 安全地重试 —— 发送一个在意图阶段创建、并存在检查点里的幂等键。在恢复测试中，转账服务跨了一次关闭与重开被调用了两次，却只应用了一次转账，因为两次调用都带着 `transfer-N`（`test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts`）。轮询句柄 —— 当远端系统返回一个操作 ID 时，先把它提交下来再去等待，然后向远端系统询问结果。generation 任务对延迟的模型调用就是这么做的（generation（p. 91））。记录中断 —— 两者都做不到时，提交一个说明效果可能发生也可能没发生的 outcome。未被标记为可重放的工具调用，也就是 `"safe"` 的，就采用这个做法（工具调用与重放（p. 94））。

nodes.text: The built-in tasks use the same shape
nodes.zh: 内置任务用的是同一个形状

nodes.text: The Harness’s own tasks follow the sandwich, which is why their recovery is predictable. The pi.tool task commits the intent { phase: "execute", arguments, replay } just before running the tool. replay comes from the tool and defaults to "unsafe" src/harness/tool.ts. In a normal run the same phase goes on to run the tool and commit the result, so the execute phase “is reached only by recovery”. There it reruns the tool only if both the stored and the current policy say safe. Otherwise it commits the call as failed with Tool NAME was interrupted and may have partially run. The pi.generation task polls. When a provider answers with a deferred handle, the task commits a poll checkpoint with the handle and a pollAt time. A crash anywhere in that loop reopens at a checkpoint that still names the remote operation, and the abort handler can cancel it with the stored handle src/harness/generation.ts.
nodes.zh: Harness 自己的任务也遵循这个三明治，所以它们的恢复是可预测的。`pi.tool` 任务在运行工具之前刚好提交意图 `{ phase: "execute", arguments, replay }`。`replay` 来自该工具，默认是 `"unsafe"`（`src/harness/tool.ts`）。在正常运行中，同一个阶段接着运行工具并提交结果，所以 execute 阶段「只会在恢复时被到达」。在那里，只有当存储的策略和当前策略都说是 safe 时，它才重跑工具。否则它把这次调用提交为失败，并带上 `Tool NAME was interrupted and may have partially run`。`pi.generation` 任务则轮询。当供应商返回一个延迟句柄时，任务提交一个带该句柄和 `pollAt` 时间的轮询检查点。这个循环中任何地方崩溃，重开都会落在一个仍然指名远端操作的检查点上，而中止处理器可以用存下来的句柄取消它（`src/harness/generation.ts`）。

nodes.text: Pi Durable never undoes an outside effect. A failed commit rolls back only the Harness’s own records (when a commit fails (p. 33)). Undoing a charge is up to the remote system: its idempotency keys, its cancel endpoint, its operation handles (limits and non-goals (p. 168)).
nodes.zh: Pi Durable 从不撤销外部效果。提交失败只回滚 Harness 自己的记录（提交失败时（p. 33））。撤销一次扣款是远端系统的事：它的幂等键、它的取消端点、它的操作句柄（限制与非目标（p. 168））。

nodes.text: Create the key in the intent phase. A key created inside the effect phase changes on every rerun and defeats deduplication. Example 12 derives it from the task ID; the shop capture commits "key": "charge-a" at seq 4, before any charge. Commit the outcome and its consequences together. A terminal commit atomically writes the outcome, appends result entries, retires the task’s documents and settles any submissions it answers spec §5.3. Two commits would leave a window where the receipt exists but the task is still live.
nodes.zh: 在意图阶段创建键。在效果阶段内部创建的键每次重跑都会变，去重就失效了。示例 12 从任务 ID 推导出它；商店抓取在序号 4 处、在任何扣款之前提交了 `"key": "charge-a"`。把结果和它的后果一起提交。一次 terminal 提交会原子地写入 outcome、追加 result 条目、退休该任务的文档，并结清它所回复的提交项（spec §5.3）。分两次提交会留下一个窗口：回执已经存在，任务却还活着。

nodes.text: Guard a second effect in the same phase with a memo. The shop order’s charge phase calls the service only if memo chargeId is empty (seq 5, then seq 6). A crash between the call and the memo still repeats the call, so the call itself must tolerate that.
nodes.zh: 用一个 memo 守住同一阶段里的第二个效果。商店订单的 charge 阶段只在 memo `chargeId` 为空时才调用服务（序号 5，然后序号 6）。调用与 memo 之间崩溃仍会重复这次调用，所以调用本身必须容忍这一点。

nodes.text: 5 . 4 The scheduler
nodes.zh: 5.4 调度器

nodes.text: One part of the Harness decides which task runs next, and it never ends a task just because its code is missing.
nodes.zh: Harness 中有一部分决定下一个跑哪个任务，而且它绝不会仅仅因为代码缺失就结束一个任务。

nodes.text: Restarts, upgrades and missing extensions all raise the same question: which tasks may run now, and with which code? The scheduler answers it. After this section you can say what a restarted process does with each unfinished task, why a task can stay pending forever, and what happens when you reload an extension under a running task.
nodes.zh: 重启、升级和缺失的扩展都提出同一个问题：哪些任务现在可以运行，用哪份代码？调度器给出答案。读完本节，你就能说出重启的进程会怎么处理每个未完成的任务、为什么一个任务可以永远停在 pending，以及在任务运行时重新加载扩展会发生什么。

nodes.text: Starting tasks
nodes.zh: 启动任务

nodes.text: The scheduler is the part of the Harness that starts tasks. Whenever something changes, such as a task being committed, an extension being installed, or a call to resume(), it looks for tasks that can start. A task can start when nothing is running it, it is not completing, and it is not waiting on a live task. For an abort-marked task, “waiting” means waiting for its own child work, because cleanup runs from the bottom up src/harness/scheduler.ts.
nodes.zh: 调度器是 Harness 中负责启动任务的部分。每当有什么发生变化——某个任务被提交、某个扩展被安装、一次 `resume()` 调用——它就去找可以启动的任务。当没有东西在运行它、它不是 completing、它也没有在等待一个存活的任务时，任务就可以启动。对带中止标记的任务，「等待」指的是在等它自己的子工作，因为清理是自底向上运行的（`src/harness/scheduler.ts`）。

nodes.text: Starting a task is called reservation. In one commit, the scheduler looks up each startable task’s code by its kind, sets the task to running, and creates its invocation. A waiting task goes straight to running. If the record carries an abort mark, the invocation runs the abort handler instead of the phases spec §5.4.
nodes.zh: 启动一个任务称为预留。在一次提交里，调度器按 kind 查找每个可启动任务的代码，把任务置为 running，并创建它的 invocation。等待中的任务直接进入 running。如果记录带有中止标记，invocation 就运行中止处理器而不是各个阶段（spec §5.4）。

nodes.text: The scheduler looks up a task’s code by kind; a task no code can take stays pending, and only an abort ends it, as orphaned. The table of spec §5.4, implemented in src/harness/scheduler.ts. A migrated record is committed together with running.
nodes.zh: 调度器按 kind 查找任务的代码；没有代码能接手的任务会一直停在 pending，只有中止才会让它以 orphaned 结束。spec §5.4 的表格，实现在 `src/harness/scheduler.ts`。迁移过的记录与 running 一起提交。

nodes.text: Blocked tasks
nodes.zh: 被阻塞的任务

nodes.text: A task is blocked when no registered code fits it. A blocked task has not failed. Its record stays unchanged, it still counts as unfinished work for idle waits, and the scheduler tries again whenever the registry changes. Blocked is “derived runtime state, not a persisted task status” spec §5.4.
nodes.zh: 当没有已注册的代码适配它时，任务就被阻塞。被阻塞的任务并没有失败。它的记录保持不变，它对空闲等待来说仍算未完成的工作，而注册表每次变化时调度器都会重试。阻塞是「推导出的运行时状态，不是被持久化的任务状态」（spec §5.4）。

nodes.text: In the recovery test, a task with a missing definition stays pending until addTask() registers it, and then completes test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts. Use harness.inspect() to find blocked tasks. It reports { kind: "blocked", reason } for each one (the task graph and inspect() (p. 137)). Migration runs when the task is reserved. One callback, migrate(input, checkpoint, fromVersion), upgrades records from every older version. If it throws, the error is reported once through onReport, and the scheduler tries again only after a different definition is registered for that kind. A newer definition without migrate blocks with Task test.versioned version 2 has no migration from 1 test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 在恢复测试中，一个缺失定义的任务会一直停在 pending，直到 `addTask()` 注册它，然后才完成（`test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts`）。用 `harness.inspect()` 找出被阻塞的任务。它为每个任务报告 `{ kind: "blocked", reason }`（任务图与 `inspect()`（p. 137））。迁移在任务被预留时运行。一个回调 `migrate(input, checkpoint, fromVersion)` 把记录从每个更旧的版本升级上来。如果它抛出，错误通过 `onReport` 报告一次，调度器要等到为该 kind 注册了一个不同的定义才会再试。一个没有 migrate 的更新定义会阻塞并报 `Task test.versioned version 2 has no migration from 1`（`test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: After a crash: reopening
nodes.zh: 崩溃之后：重开

nodes.text: When you open a Harness on existing storage, the scheduler makes one cleanup commit. Every task left running goes back to pending with the same checkpoint and memos. Nothing runs yet: the open “dispatches nothing” src/harness/scheduler.ts. Handlers start after resume(), or after a call that needs progress such as waitForTask() or submit() spec §2.2. Open also schedules a second commit that applies any abort marks and final outcomes a crash left half done.
nodes.zh: 当你在已有存储上打开一个 Harness 时，调度器会做一次清理提交。每个留在 running 的任务都带着同样的检查点和 memos 退回 pending。此时还不会有什么运行：打开阶段「不分发任何东西」（`src/harness/scheduler.ts`）。处理器在 `resume()` 之后启动，或者在需要进展的调用之后启动，比如 `waitForTask()` 或 `submit()`（spec §2.2）。打开时还会安排第二次提交，应用崩溃留下的任何中止标记和最终结果。

nodes.text: Reloading code under a running task
nodes.zh: 在运行中的任务下重新加载代码

nodes.text: A running invocation keeps the code it started with. At each phase boundary the step checks the registry again. If a different definition for the kind is now registered and can take the task (the same version, or a newer one with migrate), the task hands over. The step sets it back to pending with its checkpoint, memos and abort mark, and the next reservation runs it under the new code spec §5.4. The handover test logs old:a start, old:a end, new:b start, so old and new code never overlap test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts. If the new code cannot take the task, the old code keeps running and the problem is reported once. “A handler that never settles never hands over.” Reload while running (p. 118) shows this in practice.
nodes.zh: 一个运行中的 invocation 会一直用它启动时的代码。在每个阶段边界，step 都会重新检查注册表。如果现在为该 kind 注册了另一个定义并且它能接手这个任务（同一版本，或带 migrate 的更新版本），任务就交接。step 把它带着检查点、memos 和中止标记置回 pending，下一次预留就在新代码下运行它（spec §5.4）。交接测试会记录 `old:a start`、`old:a end`、`new:b start`，新旧代码从不重叠（`test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts`）。如果新代码接不了手，旧代码继续运行，问题被报告一次。「一个永不settle 的处理器永不交接。」「在运行时重新加载」（p. 118）在实践中展示了这一点。

nodes.zh: 关闭

nodes.text: close() stops new work, rejects pending waitForTask() and idle waits with a closed error, signals every invocation, and waits for them to return. It writes no outcome and sets no mark, so all work resumes on reopen spec §5.1. A handler that ignores its signal keeps close() waiting spec §12. Details

nodes.zh: 如果存储拒绝这次预留提交，这些预留会在内存中撤销，错误交给 `onReport`，下一轮

nodes.text: pass tries again. The test task still runs exactly once test/harness-tasks.test.ts. If the process dies during that commit, the
nodes.zh: 再试。测试任务仍然恰好运行一次（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。如果进程在那次提交期间死掉，

nodes.text: After a crash, every running task restarts at its last checkpoint. Write each phase so it can run again. A task that sits pending forever is usually blocked. Check harness.inspect(). When a checkpoint’s shape changes, raise version and ship a migrate that accepts every older version. Let handlers honour their signal, so close() and handover are quick.

nodes.text: 5 . 5 Ownership and structured concurrency
nodes.zh: 5.5 所有权与结构化并发

nodes.text: Work a task starts belongs to it: the task cannot finish before that work does, and aborting the task aborts the work.
nodes.zh: 任务启动的工作归属于它：任务不会早于那些工作结束，而中止任务也会中止那些工作。

nodes.text: A checkout starts four card payments. It should not report done while a payment is still in flight, and if the customer cancels, the payments should be aborted too. Ownership gives you both. After this section you can create child tasks, wait for them with the right policy, and predict when a task holds as completing.
nodes.zh: 一次结账发起了四笔卡支付。它不该在还有支付在途时报告 done；如果顾客取消，这些支付也应该被中止。所有权给了你两者。读完本节，你就能创建子任务、用正确的策略等待它们，并预测一个任务何时会一直挂在 completing。

nodes.text: One ownership tree
nodes.zh: 一棵所有权树

nodes.text: Every task has an owner, set when it is created and never changed. You pass it as ownership in tx.createTask(task, input, { ownership }) spec §5.5: { kind: "conversation" } — a top-level task, owned by its conversation. { kind: "task", taskId } — a child task, owned by another task and always in that task’s conversation. Conversations can have owners too. A subagent’s conversation is owned by the tool task that created it (owned conversations (p. 43)). Together, tasks and conversations form one tree. Forks play no part in it.
nodes.zh: 每个任务都有一个 owner，在创建时设定，永不改变。你通过 `tx.createTask(task, input, { ownership })` 传入它（spec §5.5）：`{ kind: "conversation" }` —— 顶层任务，由它的会话拥有。`{ kind: "task", taskId }` —— 子任务，由另一个任务拥有，并且始终在那个任务的会话中。会话也可以有 owner。子智能体的会话由创建它的那个工具任务拥有（被拥有的会话（p. 43））。合起来，任务与会话构成一棵树。分叉在其中不起作用。

nodes.text: Tasks and conversations form one ownership tree, and a background task cuts off the subtree below it. The foreground subagent of README §Abort and Subagents and ex 22, beside the background anchor of ex 23. A generation owns its tool tasks (README §Concepts).
nodes.zh: 任务与会话构成一棵所有权树，而后台任务会把它下方的子树切掉。README §Abort and Subagents 与示例 22 的前台子智能体，旁边是示例 23 的后台锚点。一个 generation 拥有它的工具任务（README §Concepts）。

nodes.text: The owner must be live when the child is created: not completing, not terminal, not abort-marked. The check uses the state the commit will leave behind src/session/transaction.ts. So a task cannot create a child in the same commit that finishes it. The shop capture’s scenario D tries exactly that. The commit rejects with Task owner 12 is completing, the phase throws, and the task faults at seq 27. Create children in one commit, and finish in a later one.
nodes.zh: 创建子任务时 owner 必须存活：不是 completing、不是 terminal、没有中止标记。这个检查用的是提交完成后会留下的状态（`src/session/transaction.ts`）。所以任务不能在结束自己的那次提交里创建子任务。商店抓取的场景 D 正是这么试的。提交被拒绝，报 `Task owner 12 is completing`，该阶段抛出，任务在序号 27 处进入故障。在一次提交里创建子任务，在之后的一次提交里结束。

nodes.text: Foreground and background work
nodes.zh: 前台与后台工作

nodes.text: A task’s owned work is everything below it in the tree: its children, the tasks in conversations it owns, and so on down. The spec calls this the ordinary owned work, and it stops at background tasks. A background task is a conversation-owned task created with background: true. Ordinary waits and aborts skip it “and its complete owned subtree” spec §5.4. Idle waits use the same rule: Conversation.waitForIdle() returns once no live foreground task remains below the conversation.
nodes.zh: 一个任务拥有的工作就是树中它下方的所有东西：它的子任务、它拥有的会话里的任务，如此往下。规范称之为普通的被拥有工作，它在后台任务处停下。后台任务是用 `background: true` 创建的、由会话拥有的任务。普通的等待和中止会跳过它「及其完整的被拥有子树」（spec §5.4）。空闲等待用同样的规则：`Conversation.waitForIdle()` 在会话下方不再有存活的前台任务时返回。

nodes.text: Waiting on tasks
nodes.zh: 等待任务

nodes.text: A phase waits by returning { status: "waiting", checkpoint, on, policy }. The task then has no invocation. When every task in on has finished, it resumes at checkpoint and reads their outcomes, in order, with runtime.outcomes(ids). Example 24’s checkout creates four payments and waits on them in the same commit:
nodes.zh: 一个阶段通过返回 `{ status: "waiting", checkpoint, on, policy }` 来等待。此时任务没有 invocation。当 `on` 中的每个任务都完成时，它从 `checkpoint` 恢复，并用 `runtime.outcomes(ids)` 按顺序读取它们的结果。示例 24 的结账在同一次提交里创建四笔支付并等待它们：

nodes.text: create children and wait, in one commit test/examples/24-child-tasks.ts TS
nodes.zh: 在一次提交里创建子任务并等待 test/examples/24-child-tasks.ts TS

nodes.text: The rules for on are checked when the wait is committed, and breaking one faults the task src/harness/scheduler.ts:
nodes.zh: `on` 的规则在等待被提交时检查，违反其中一条就会让任务进入故障（`src/harness/scheduler.ts`）：

nodes.text: on may not name a missing task, the task itself, or one of its owners, “which could never finish first”.
nodes.zh: `on` 不能指一个缺失的任务、任务自身，或它自己的某个 owner，「因为那些永远不可能先完成」。

nodes.text: failFast may name only tasks the waiter owns. allSettled may name any task, even one already finished.
nodes.zh: `failFast` 只能指等待者拥有的任务。`allSettled` 可以指任何任务，甚至已经完成的。

nodes.text: An empty on resumes at the next scheduling pass.
nodes.zh: 空的 `on` 会在下一轮调度时恢复。

nodes.text: An abort handler cannot wait at all.
nodes.zh: 中止处理器完全不能等待。

nodes.text: allSettled or failFast The policy decides what happens to the other tasks when one fails. With allSettled, nothing happens: the waiter resumes when the last task ends, whatever the outcomes. With failFast, “the first task in on that holds or ends with a non-completed outcome gives every other live task in on an abort mark, in the scheduler’s next reconcile commit” spec §5.5. The waiter itself is not aborted. It resumes and decides its own outcome.
nodes.zh: allSettled 还是 failFast —— 策略决定一个任务失败时其他任务会怎样。用 `allSettled` 时什么也不会发生：最后一个任务结束时等待者就恢复，不管结果如何。用 `failFast` 时，「`on` 中第一个挂起或以非 completed 结果结束的任务，会在下一次对账提交中给 `on` 里其他每个存活任务打上中止标记」（spec §5.5）。等待者自身不会被中止。它恢复后自己决定结果。

nodes.text: completing: the owner waits for its work
nodes.zh: completing：owner 等待它的工作

nodes.text: If a task finishes while its owned work is still running, it is committed as { status: "completing", outcome }. The result is fixed, but the task is not done. Once nothing live remains below it, the scheduler commits the final terminal record spec §5.5. The shop order shows it end to end:
nodes.zh: 如果一个任务结束时它拥有的工作还在运行，它会被提交为 `{ status: "completing", outcome }`。结果已定，但任务还没完成。一旦它下方不再有存活的东西，调度器就提交最终的 terminal 记录（spec §5.5）。商店订单完整展示了这一点：

nodes.text: A held outcome follows five rules spec §5.5:
nodes.zh: 被挂起的结果遵循五条规则（spec §5.5）：

nodes.text: It is final. No phase or abort handler runs again, and the task is never restarted or migrated.
nodes.zh: 它是最终的。不会再有阶段或中止处理器运行，任务也不会被重启或迁移。

nodes.text: Aborting a completing task only marks it, which aborts the work below. The final record keeps the held outcome.
nodes.zh: 中止一个 completing 的任务只会给它打标记，从而中止它下方的工作。最终记录保留被挂起的结果。

nodes.text: A held outcome other than completed counts as cancellation intent, so the work below is aborted first. Such a held failure
nodes.zh: completed 以外的挂起结果意味着取消意图，所以它下方的工作会先被中止。这样一个挂起的失败

nodes.zh: 还会在自己的工作排空之前触发 failFast（`test/harness-structured.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: Writes split at the hold. Entries and documents from the finishing commit land at once. The terminal state, the retirement of
nodes.zh: 写入在挂起处被分开。来自结束提交中的条目和文档会立即落地。terminal 状态、该任务文档的

nodes.text: the task’s documents, and its waiters wait for the final commit.
nodes.zh: 退休，以及它的等待者，都要等到最终提交。

nodes.text: Waiters, idle waits and inspect() all treat a completing task as live.
nodes.zh: 等待者、空闲等待和 `inspect()` 都把 completing 的任务视为存活。

nodes.text: Foreground work an extension starts in a subagent’s conversation holds the calling tool, and with it the whole run. Asking a subagent more questions while its tool is completing extends the hold. Create work that should not hold its owner as conversation-owned and background spec §12.
nodes.zh: 扩展在一个子智能体会话里启动的前台工作会挂住调用它的工具，进而挂住整个运行。在某个工具还在 completing 时再问子智能体更多问题，会延长这个挂起。应该不挂住自己 owner 的工作，就创建成会话拥有的后台任务（spec §12）。

nodes.text: Make a task the owner of any work its result depends on. Use failFast for all-or-nothing children, and allSettled when you want every result. Create children in one commit and finish in a later one. Use a background, conversation-owned task for work that must not hold its caller.
nodes.zh: 让一个任务成为其结果所依赖的任何工作的 owner。对全有或全无的子任务用 failFast，对你想要每个结果的情形用 allSettled。在一次提交里创建子任务，在之后的一次提交里结束。对不该挂住调用者的工作，用会话拥有的后台任务。

5 . 6 Abort, fault and orphan
nodes.zh: 5.6 中止、故障与孤儿

nodes.text: An abort is a committed mark that flows down the tree; each task’s own handler decides how to clean up, after everything below it has finished.
nodes.zh: 中止是一个会向下流遍整棵树的已提交标记；每个任务自己的处理器决定怎么清理，时机在它下方的一切都结束之后。

nodes.text: Aborting work that has touched the outside world takes more than stopping it: a charged card needs a refund. Pi Durable lets each task decide how to clean up, and runs the cleanups in a safe order. After this section you can write an abort handler that compensates correctly, read an abort in storage, and tell from a record whether any cleanup ran.
nodes.zh: 中止已经触及外部世界的工作，需要的不只是停下来：一张已经扣过款的卡需要退款。Pi Durable 让每个任务自己决定如何清理，并按安全的顺序执行这些清理。读完本节，你就能写出正确补偿的中止处理器、从存储中读出一次中止，并从记录中看出是否有过任何清理。

nodes.text: How an abort works
nodes.zh: 中止如何工作

nodes.text: You abort a task with harness.abortTask(id). It does not stop the task on the spot. It commits a flag on the record, abortRequested, called the abort mark. Five steps follow spec §5.4: 1. Commit abortRequested on the task. 2. Signal the running invocation, if there is one, and wait for it to return. 3. Wait until the task’s owned work has finished. 4. Start a new invocation that runs the abort handler. 5. The abort handler commits a final outcome. abortTask() does steps 1 and 2 and returns "marked". It returns "terminal" for a task that has already finished, and rejects for an unknown ID. It does not wait for the cleanup; use waitForTask() to see the final outcome spec §2.2. If you stop waiting by cancelling your own context, the mark is already committed and the abort goes ahead test/harness-tasks.test.ts. Once the mark is committed, the running phase can no longer commit anything. Every runtime.commit() and memo write rejects with Task N has a durable abort mark, and the next step ends the run (rule 3 of the step (p. 67)). The abort handler runs later, in a new invocation. It still sees the record’s memos, and it runs once test/harness-tasks.test.ts.
nodes.zh: 用 `harness.abortTask(id)` 中止一个任务。它不会当场停掉任务。它在记录上提交一个标志 `abortRequested`，称为中止标记。随后是五个步骤（spec §5.4）：1. 在任务上提交 `abortRequested`。2. 向运行中的 invocation（如果存在）发信号，并等待它返回。3. 一直等到该任务拥有的工作完成。4. 启动一个新的 invocation 运行中止处理器。5. 中止处理器提交一个最终 outcome。`abortTask()` 只做第 1、2 步并返回 `"marked"`。对一个已经完成的任务，它返回 `"terminal"`；对未知 ID 则 reject。它不等待清理；要看到最终结果请用 `waitForTask()`（spec §2.2）。如果你通过取消自己的 context 停止等待，标记已经提交，中止照常进行（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。标记一旦提交，正在运行的阶段就不能再提交任何东西。每次 `runtime.commit()` 和 memo 写入都会 reject，报 `Task N has a durable abort mark`，而下一次 step 会结束这次运行（step 的规则 3（p. 67））。中止处理器稍后在一个新的 invocation 中运行。它仍然能看到记录里的 memos，并且只运行一次（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: The abort handler must decide the outcome, usually aborted. Returning without one faults the task with Abort handler of task N returned without a terminal outcome, and a throw faults it with the thrown message. The handler cannot wait and cannot create child tasks, because its own task is marked src/harness/scheduler.ts; spec §5.5. To compensate, act inline, or create background conversation-owned tasks and wait for them with runtime.waitForTask() spec §12.
nodes.zh: 中止处理器必须决定结果，通常是 aborted。不返回结果会让任务进入故障，报 `Abort handler of task N returned without a terminal outcome`；抛出则以抛出的消息让它进入故障。该处理器不能等待，也不能创建子任务，因为它自己的任务已被标记（`src/harness/scheduler.ts`；spec §5.5）。要补偿就就地行动，或者创建会话拥有的后台任务并用 `runtime.waitForTask()` 等待它们（spec §12）。

nodes.text: The abort flows down, cleanup runs up
nodes.zh: 中止向下流，清理向上跑

nodes.text: An abort spreads to the work below. A live task passes it on when it carries an abort mark, or when it holds a completing outcome other than completed. The spec calls either one cancellation intent, and it “cascades idempotently to foreground- owned work” spec §5.4. The scheduler commits the children’s marks in a separate commit, “and again at open, so a crash in between loses nothing”. Example 24’s aborted checkout runs the whole protocol in eight commits, seq 17 to 24, shown in the figure below. The order is guaranteed. A marked task’s abort handler cannot start while its owned work is live, so “an abort handler sees final outcomes below it”. While it waits, inspect() shows the checkout as { kind: "waiting", on: [child] }. In the three- level test, each handler logs that the level below is already terminal test/harness-structured.test.ts. The cascade has limits spec §5.4:

nodes.text: Orphaned, faulted, aborted
nodes.zh: orphaned、faulted、aborted

nodes.text: Orphaned. A blocked task cannot run its abort handler, because that code is missing or cannot take the task. So aborting it ends it as orphaned, with the blocked reason as reason. The recovery test aborts a task with a missing definition before resume() and reads { status: "orphaned", reason: "missing_task" }, with the task’s documents already retired test/harness- tasks-recovery.test.ts. Only an abort orphans a task. Missing code alone never does. Faulted. Faults come from task bugs, malformed provider data, or a commit that storage rejected cleanly (StorageRejected). An uncertain storage failure stops the Session instead and writes no outcome (when a commit fails (p. 33)). If storage rejects the fault itself, the task stays running and runs again at the next reservation test/harness-tasks.test.ts.
nodes.zh: orphaned —— 被阻塞的任务无法运行它的中止处理器，因为那份代码缺失或接不了这个任务。所以中止它会让它以 orphaned 结束，reason 就是被阻塞的原因。恢复测试在 `resume()` 之前中止一个缺失定义的任务，读到 `{ status: "orphaned", reason: "missing_task" }`，该任务的文档已被退休（`test/harness-tasks-recovery.test.ts`）。只有中止会让一个任务成为孤儿。仅仅代码缺失永远不会。faulted —— 故障来自任务 bug、格式不合的供应商数据，或一次被存储干净地拒绝的提交（`StorageRejected`）。不确定的存储失败会改为停掉 Session 且不写 outcome（提交失败时（p. 33））。如果存储连这条故障也拒绝，任务会保持 running，并在下一次预留时再次运行（`test/harness-tasks.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: Details: cleanup for the built-in tasks For the two outcomes the Harness writes itself, faulted and orphaned, it runs one cleanup hook in the commit that makes the outcome final src/harness/live.ts; spec §5.4. Only three kinds use it: pi.generation — when it is the current run’s task, a committed partial reply becomes an aborted pi.assistant entry, the run’s inputs become unanswered with reason faulted or the blocked reason, and the run ends (run control (p. 88)). pi.tool — marks the tool call done without a result entry. The run continues, and the missing result is filled in when the model context is built (context (p. 40)). pi.compaction — clears the compaction status (compaction (p. 97)).
nodes.zh: 细节：内置任务的清理 —— 对于 Harness 自己写入的两种结果 faulted 和 orphaned，它会在让该结果定下的那次提交里运行一个清理钩子（`src/harness/live.ts`；spec §5.4）。只有三种任务会用它：`pi.generation` —— 当它是当前运行的任务时，一条已提交的半截回复变成一条 aborted 的 `pi.assistant` 条目，该运行的输入变成无人回复，原因为 faulted 或被阻塞的原因，运行结束（运行控制（p. 88））。`pi.tool` —— 把这次工具调用标记为 done，但没有结果条目。运行继续，缺失的结果会在构建模型上下文时补上（context（p. 40））。`pi.compaction` —— 清掉压缩状态（压缩（p. 97））。

Compensate inline, or through background tasks. An abort handler cannot create child tasks or wait on them. Treat orphaned and faulted as “nothing cleaned up”. Check the outside world yourself.
